package.purpose: First-planet playable journey with persistent surface fog, artifact restoration, collection, base and day/night; continues the existing v037 campaign and preserves prior source backups

method: A simplified exploration. Existing ordinary reducers produce fixtures and audited ownership; native wall clock after seeding. No personal profile, injected resources/condition, fabricated timer/reward, poster crop, or assembled video.

assistLedger.initialStateRule: Before the first accepted tap the real engine may have no optional assist object; those prior counters are zero

streams.codec_long_name: H.264 / AVC / MPEG-4 AVC / MPEG-4 part 10

video.source: Native 1x viewport WebM, one MP4 transcode; only loading/end trim. No spliced frames or accelerated action time.
